howto.name: Upload a PNG
howto.text: Drop a PNG — transparency is preserved in the WebP output.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The result is a WebP that is usually 60–80% smaller than the source PNG.

faq.a: Lossless WebP is typically 25% smaller than PNG; lossy WebP is dramatically smaller. Either way, you save bandwidth — useful for web assets, icons, and product images.
Yes. WebP supports an alpha channel exactly like PNG, so transparent areas come through unchanged.

faq.q: When should I stay with PNG?
faq.a: If you need maximum compatibility with very old software, PDF generators, or print pipelines — PNG is supported everywhere.
